question: to the Commission Aldo Patriciello (PfE) Subject:

The increasingly frequent use of artificial intelligence in production processes and administration highlights the need to bridge the digital divide among small and medium-sized enterprises and public administration by leveraging automation and analytics tools. The absence of structured training pathways could hamper the competitiveness and efficiency of public services, thereby harming the European economic fabric. The failure to promptly implement coordinated measures is likely to exacerbate territorial and technological disparities, thereby preventing small companies from accessing global markets and keeping up with modern digital efficiency standards. In the light of the above, could the Commission clarify whether it will develop funded training programmes and common guidelines to support the secure uptake of AI by SMEs and public administration?
